fields.description: Issue features extensive political commentary and reporting centered on Florida racing interests and proposed legislation described as a “40%” petition requirement affecting race track permits, with discussion of Hialeah and Tropical Park and the impact on Miami/Dade County business. Coverage also includes allegations and calls for grand jury investigation involving former state’s attorney Vernon Hawthorne, references to the Miami Daily News, and discussion of past criminal cases. Regular sections include sports and racing-related columns and results, local society/club notes, letters to the editor, and substantial local business advertising.
